title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission System
features.description: A feature allowing users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Profiles for users to track their progress, solved problems, and rankings.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: A ranking system to display top users based on problem-solving performance.

features.name: Hints and Tutorials
features.description: Hints and educational resources to help users learn and improve their problem-solving skills.

constraints: Must handle high traffic and concurrent users
Requires a robust backend for code execution and evaluation
target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and performance metrics
